import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] b = new long[20];

    public static long compute(long x, int s) {
        long quotient = x / b[s];
        x %= b[s];
        if (x == 0)
            return quotient * s;
        else
            return quotient * s + Math.min(compute(x, s - 1), s + compute(b[s] - x, s - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i)
            b[i] = b[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long temp = n;
        int length = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            temp /= 10;
            ++length;
        }
        System.out.println(compute(n, length + 2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
